text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right~, it's finally time for "Tokujiro the Helpful Samurai" to air~.
Hehe, it's what I look forward to all week...♪

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"An unidentified flying object has been spotted over Fuchu!!
We interrupt our regularly scheduled program to bring you this breaking news!!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is this a special broadcast?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I was really looking forward to seeing how Tokujiro-san would do this week, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute looked dejected after her favorite
period drama was preempted by a breaking news special.
